name: OrchestrationBench
description: OrchestrationBench is a bilingual benchmark evaluating LLM-driven agentic planning and tool use across 17 domains with nearly 100 virtual tools. It separately assesses workflow-based planning and constraint-aware tool execution, including tool selection, argument extraction, validation, and rejection handling, emphasizing structured planning evaluation.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for agentic planning and tool use that is useful for research, but it is not yet broadly established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Manually annotated with cultural adaptation; disentangles planning from tool execution evaluation; designed as a living benchmark.
